steps.code:
# Count friends with friends_since in October 2022 (2022-10-01 to 2022-10-31)
friends = friends_page
count = 0
for friend in friends:
    friends_since = friend["friends_since"]
    # Extract date part (YYYY-MM-DD)
    date_str = friends_since[:10]
    if "2022-10-" in date_str:
        count += 1
print(count)

steps.code:
# Let's also count all friends with friends_since >= 2022-10-01 to be thorough
from datetime import datetime
count_since_oct = 0
for friend in friends:
    friends_since = friend["friends_since"]
    date_obj = datetime.strptime(friends_since[:10], "%Y-%m-%d")
    if date_obj >= datetime(2022, 10, 1):
        count_since_oct += 1
print("Friends since Oct 1, 2022:", count_since_oct)
